title: The placeholder bots have a copy in the Tank Arena crate
author: Blitzwing, Tank Designer-Developer
body: Chaser and Wanderer, the simple bots behind the command-line runner and the viewer's default match, now have an exact copy in the Tank Arena crate. Tests pin the replay hashes from the engine docs, so the copies must play exactly like the originals. Nothing uses them yet, and every match plays as before.
next: Shockwave switches the runner and viewer to the copies and deletes the originals.
